label: 3D and game looks
description: Specific 3D rendering, pixel-art, retro-game, flat graphic, technical visualization, and digital glitch looks.
notes: Named digital rendering looks belong here, phrased as article-led noun phrases after “made as.” art.medium owns broad processes such as digital painting and 3D rendering; art.style owns movements and general illustration styles. Retro hardware looks use descriptive names without product or studio brands, and cel shading covers the overlapping toon-shading term. Technical and glitch entries change the depiction itself rather than the era or genre of its subject.
